title: Aether Forge Delegated Signer Declaration
description: Declarative shape for configuring a signer that fulfills the DelegatedSigner protocol (`aether_forge.crypto.signers`). v0.22.0+ (Sprint 2.3 / FP-3). Used by hosted-marketplace patterns where the agent's own OWS wallet is NOT the EIP-3009 signer (e.g. a browser-side wallet via relay, an HSM-backed delegated secret, or a constrained session key on top of any of the above).

kind.description: Discriminator for the signer implementation. `ows` is the agent-owned OWS wallet (legacy default). `browser-relay` POSTs typed-data payloads to a user-configured HTTP endpoint and expects {"signature": "0x…"} back. `delegated-secret` resolves a signing callable from a CredentialResolver lease. `mock` is for tests only.

owsAgentDirectory.description: Required when kind=ows. Path to the forge-provisioned agent directory whose wallet performs the signing.

browserRelayUrl.description: Required when kind=browser-relay. HTTPS URL that accepts POST {typedData, intent} and returns {signature}.

browserRelayAuthHeader.description: Optional Authorization header forwarded to the relay (e.g. `Bearer sk_relay_…`).

credentialHandleId.description: Required when kind=delegated-secret. The handle id resolved by CredentialResolver to fetch the actual signing callable.

credentialEnvironment.description: Environment passed to CredentialResolver.resolve. Defaults to the runtime session's environment when omitted.

sessionKey.description: Optional SessionKeyConstrainedSigner wrapper applied around the chosen inner signer. Required when the agent's deployment profile is staging or production and the signer is not already inherently scoped.
